name: What measures are taken to prevent mold growth after raw sewage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What measures are taken to prevent mold growth after raw sewage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold growth is a critical part of raw sewage cleanup. After removing all contaminated porous materials and thoroughly cleaning and disinfecting surfaces, powerful industrial-grade air movers and dehumidifiers are used to rapidly dry the affected area. Moisture levels are continuously monitored to ensure everything is completely dry. Additionally, antimicrobial treatments are applied to inhibit any remaining microbial growth. This comprehensive drying and treatment process is essential to prevent secondary mold issues and ensure a healthy environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold is prevented by removing contaminated materials, thorough drying with industrial equipment, continuous moisture monitoring, and applying antimicrobial treatments after cleanup.
